en.title: Legato Launches AI-Powered Hearing Glasses Amid Global Accessibility Advances
en.summary: Legato has unveiled AI-powered hearing glasses designed to assist individuals with mild-to-moderate hearing loss, backed by $12M in funding. Meanwhile, Tracfone announced new accessibility partnerships marking its 30th anniversary, and Exeter residents urged local authorities to improve walkability for people with disabilities. Additionally, an AudioEye study found AI steering UK users toward least accessible web pages, while a QA Financial video highlighted digital accessibility testing best practices.

zh-TW.title: Legato 發表 AI 助聽眼鏡 推動全球無障礙技術進步
zh-TW.summary: Legato 發表 AI 驅動的助聽眼鏡，已籌得 1200 萬美元開發專為輕度至中度聽力損失人士設計的智慧眼鏡。Tracfone 慶祝成立 30 年，宣布新的無障礙合作夥伴關係以提升殘障人士服務可及性。埃克塞特居民呼籲改善街道無障礙，而 AudioEye 研究顯示英國 AI 正將用戶導向最缺乏無障礙功能的網頁，QA Financial 影片則示範數位無障礙測試方法。
